Priority, the effect on the current promotion

conditions: Behaviour is interpreted under a declared interpretation contract.

A realisation aⱼ conforms to a specification Σ when its interpreted behaviour

conditions: A domain is stated.

Semantic equivalence of realisations claims that two

Computational
equivalence claims that two realisations compute the same function at

conditions: A domain is stated.
Every applicable requirement of the referenced Formal fragment is met.
concepts.definition: Equivalence of categories and maps, additionally requiring a quasi-inverse functor and natural isomorphisms from both functor/quasi-inverse composites to the corresponding identity functors. Preservation of identities and composition by a map is a further, separate claim.

This rung adds one
requirement of its own to those items: a quasi-inverse functor, and

A specification arranged in layers is sufficient when

conditions: A task builds or assesses one successor member against its predecessor.
concepts.definition: A return with three separate claim-and-evidence heads: semantic conservation preserves a disposed predecessor claim's meaning, judged from both texts against its disposition; demonstrated reduction traces a lower-cost successor deciding path against the same predecessor path on a declared measure with tradeoffs; mere relocation moves text between owners or carriers without changed meaning or a traced deciding-path change.

Mere relocation: text moved from one owner or

concepts.label: Return of a reconstruction

conditions: One specification may have several realisations.

P0's actor-change premise, that the actor of one

concepts.label: Conformance, equivalence and qualification

grounding.quote: ## 7. Qualification of frames and of the method

A candidate frame ([REFERENCE_FRAME](REFERENCE_FRAME.md)) is qualified in

Whether the actor class

concepts.label: Adequate attention

concepts.definition: Qualification of the method by the same process it applies elsewhere, consuming the work boundary, construction/assessment relation and layered sufficiency. It creates no second qualification process.

The method is qualified the way it qualifies anything else. Qualification

The qualification population is every function and failure relation the

conditions: An activation is selected.
concepts.definition: A benchmark of a fresh actor's recovery of governing relations using only published documents, independently judged for fidelity and measured for reconstruction cost against the rc.2 corpus baseline. F27/F28 report this observable; F29/F30 report the same observation with task completion, material errors detected and cost.

grounding.quote:
For a selected activation, measure whether a fresh actor given

concepts.definition: A conformance case names its subject, mechanism under test, independently specified expected distinction and status stating what exists. A bounded-construction trial additionally declares per-actor context and total-work budgets before each run.

grounding.quote: a conformance case names its subject, the mechanism under test, an independently specified expected distinction and its status, and a status names what exists

concepts.label: Conformance cases and bounded trials

concepts.definition: A source-authored provenance register asserting conservation and relocation of predecessor clauses: UP-001 to §1; UP-022 across §§1,3,6,7; UP-008/RF-007 and generic AC-018/AC-019 separation to §2; UP-007 independence to §3 and blocking to §5, with triggers/traceability in TICKETS; RF-013 and frame/method qualification to §7; acceptance interval, AC-014 and proxy application to §5, with full proxy/identity/delegation law elsewhere; UP-015 acceptance evidence to §5 with RELEASE §9 ownership and a tenant frontier; Reconstruction Litmus to §6 with chain-specific laws in SPEC_METHOD; judgment continuity to TICKETS/ACTIVATION; reviewer triage and Executive blocking generalized while EXECUTIVE_BASELINE retains their profile instances. These are recorded source claims, not conservation judgments made here.

grounding.quote: | UP-015 as acceptance evidence | conserved; §5 states what acceptance requires of the successor disposition record; the law is restated in full in RELEASE §9, which owns the disposition values; its application to this corpus is the tenant [frontier](../frontier/PREDECESSOR_CLAIMS.md), which holds every predecessor row's disposition and locus |

concepts.label: Source disposition register

concepts.definition: EXECUTIVE_BASELINE is an optional tier-3 operational profile mapping Executive, Worker, Reviewer and specialist engagement frames onto tiers 1–2. Its named imports retain ownership of their objects and laws.

An operational
profile owns only its own bindings, the terms and choices it adds for its
operation.

the Reviewer
frame the assessor's

They separate questions about constitutional WHAT, structural HOW, identity, authority, effects, foundations, installed subjects and evidence; they are not mandatory actors, stages, components, services, files or runtime types.

Product, Product Composition, Design, Design Component, Public Boundary,
Entity, Operator, Owner, Effect, Reuse/Foundation, Install and Proof.

concepts.label: Specialist-frame families

grounding.quote:
The four product testing frames (user acceptance, end to end, integration,
unit) are tier-2 law in ASSURANCE §7.

conditions: The adopting Product's authority separately accepts it.

grounding.quote:
Adoption requires a separately
accepted Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis

concepts.label: Project Reference-Frame Basis

concepts.definition: Direct or coordinated engagement selected under ACTIVATION. Coordination is added where direct entry cannot cover material contexts, authority, capability or required independence. With the executive configuration selected, Worker/Writer is direct entry and Executive coordination.

grounding.quote:
The configuration that adds coordination where direct entry cannot cover
the material contexts, authority, capability or required independence is
selected under
[ACTIVATION §1 Configuration](ACTIVATION.md#configuration).

concepts.label: Engagement applicability and routes

conditions: A claim is load-bearing.

grounding.quote: without these it is evidence discovery, not proof. Packaging, syntax, compilation, presence, invocation or local behaviour never substitutes for a semantic, authority-bearing, installed, release or end-to-end claim because the weaker property is easier to measure

constraints.statement: Declare all six claim coordinates before selecting a witness; otherwise the activity is evidence discovery, not proof. Easier measurement of packaging, syntax, compilation, presence, invocation or local behaviour never makes it substitute for semantic, authority-bearing, installed, release or end-to-end proof.

conditions: An assurance surface supports promotion or closure.

grounding.quote: an assurance surface supporting promotion or closure binds the exact claimed subject and its authoritative composition relation

constraints.statement: Bind the exact subject and authoritative composition relation. Evidence for one file or carrier proves only that boundary; multi-file or carrier-set satisfaction and conflict are decided at the declared composite boundary, owned by the authority declaring the subject and composition.

conditions: The claim asserts mechanical enforcement.

grounding.quote: a planned or specification-only harness is planned evidence, not observed verification, and until both are observed the claim stays open or is downgraded to the planned property

constraints.statement: Name an executable or reproducible predicate and a witness reachable through the declared ordinary assurance path. Until both are observed, retain an open claim or downgrade it to the planned property. Project assurance design owns the path; observation versus planning is assessed where the claim is relied on, without a separately named cross-member consumer.

grounding.quote: a claim's quantifier, population and scope cannot exceed its evaluated evidence. Generalising a local defect or observation needs a declared inference relation, the comparable population, explicit counterexample treatment and governing evidence; later counterevidence invalidates every dependent verdict until the claim-evidence relation is superseded, withdrawn or requalified.

constraints.statement: Quantifier, population and scope cannot exceed evaluated evidence. Generalisation requires the claim author's declared inference relation and comparable population, explicit counterexample treatment and governing evidence. Later counterevidence invalidates every dependent verdict until the claim-evidence relation is superseded, withdrawn or requalified.
constraints.uncertainty: The separately referenced §1 falsifiers are not supplied.

grounding.quote: P5 (derived from P0 and P6, with P0's open-world premise)

Each consumer applies the rule and decides nothing the owning section does
not (P2, P6).

constraints.statement: Read foundation tables as source-authored traces, separating independent P1/P2/P3/P6 premises, recovered P0 premises, P5 derived from P0/P6 with open-world premise, and P4b derived from P0/P2 with non-reacquirable step facts. F6 invokes candidate-until-evaluated P0; F7 invokes actor change and finite-actor fit. Added choices remain with their named owners rather than being presented as derived. Consumers apply owning rules and decide nothing additional. F7's §8 and CONFORMANCE §6 record dispositions without deciding; CONFORMANCE §§1–4 list cases and §5 maps discriminators to cases and logical-review checks.
constraints.uncertainty: The external foundation definitions and their derivations are not independently available or adjudicated.

conditions: A named consumer applies the corresponding owning rule.

grounding.quote: where a sufficiency test is evaluated with history and folklore withheld
whose logical-review check supplies no actual-use evidence and whose coverage paragraph counts no unassessed run as actual-use evidence for this revision

constraints.statement: The consumer indexes retain these bounded applications: exact-cut and successor claims need matching evidence; reconstruction compares the complete semantic result; unit green proves no broader assurance; a composite revision updates every conformance subject to its declared carrier relation; integration proves only exercised composition. Structural document checks and Reviewer evaluation remain separate; logical review is not established structurally and supplies no actual-use evidence. Proxy authority or reuse of an author's verdict supplies no independence; a coordinator that changed a subject is not independent of it, and carrying or porting a contribution retains authorship. Review records identify exact subject, basis, scope, exclusions, evidence, verdict and unresolved findings. Invariant reconstruction withholds history and folklore. Acceptance attaches to immutable identity, adoption is assessed separately, and no review event, aggregate pass or status change substitutes for closure. Successor acceptance requires a stable successor relation. Conforming tenants may differ outside their contract; departure from execution law is recorded non-conformance, not local frame selection. No case receives a pass without being run and independently assessed on the relevant revision.
constraints.uncertainty: These are supplied descriptions of consumer applications; the cited consumer texts and discriminator cases are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
Semantic law defines what an evaluation means;
evidence supplies observations; the evaluator applies the declared
relation; decision authority disposes. One actor may lawfully perform
several; the record keeps them distinguishable.

constraints.statement: Keep the semantic basis, evidence basis and state projection distinct, and distinguish semantic law, observations, evaluator application and decision disposition in the record even when one actor lawfully performs several roles. EVALUATION owns the separation; RF-007 and AC-018 add only frame and model bindings.

grounding.quote:
A semantic change requires lawful re-entry and invalidates affected
downstream acceptance. A broad digest may conservatively
invalidate a review; it does not prove that every semantic relation
changed

constraints.statement: Evidence changes can invalidate verdicts without changed law; ACTIVATION §7 decides applicability, and an applicable invalidation is mandatory before reliance. Projection changes can invalidate views without changed semantic truth; ACTIVATION §2 decides staleness. Semantic changes require lawful re-entry and invalidate affected downstream acceptance. A changed broad digest establishes changed representation, not change to every semantic relation.
constraints.uncertainty: The external reuse, staleness and semantic-change re-entry rules are unresolved here.

exceptions: A checker may claim a semantic or authority subset under an exact lawful decision contract supplied by its model.

grounding.quote:
A valid parse, a valid map, a green test and a historical judgment each
establish exactly their own claim. Evidence bound to a basis other than
the evaluated one is excluded by basis; it is not admitted with a narrower
scope

constraints.statement: Structural success supports but does not replace semantic review. A checker decides the structural subset subject to the stated decision-contract exception. Valid parsing, mapping, tests and historical judgments establish only their own claims. Evidence bound to another basis is excluded, not admitted with narrower scope. AC-018/AC-019 bind this rule to a_c records and model validity.
constraints.uncertainty: No model-specific lawful decision contract is supplied.

conditions: Promotion requires independent assessment.

grounding.quote:
A constructor's self-review is construction output, not assessment. Where
promotion needs independent assessment, the assessor evaluates the exact
live subject, authority paths, proof and installed state, not the
constructor's summary

constraints.statement: Assess the exact live subject, authority paths, proof and installed state rather than the constructor's summary. Self-review remains construction output, including in a fresh context. Fresh context supplies neither independence nor missing review authority. A received contribution retains its author wherever carried, and that author's reading supplies no independent acceptance. Independence depends on authorship and evidence conditions, not actor naming or context changes.

grounding.quote:
The assessor records its
expectations from the governing source before opening the candidate; it
reads the subject at that identity or relation, never a mutable working
tree; it makes no repair; it does not assess its
own authorship.

constraints.statement: For method qualification freeze the subject by identity before material reference exposure; elsewhere stabilise it by immutable identity or an equivalent exact-subject relation sufficient for the assessment claim. Record source-derived expectations before opening the candidate. Read that subject, never a mutable tree; perform no repair and assess no own authorship. Every post-exposure revision is a declared intervention, classified either as a method constituent with its own qualification boundary or as a new qualification subject; it cannot retroactively pass the original frozen construction.

grounding.quote:
Membership in a plan authenticates nothing,
an unauthenticated result satisfies no required assessment, and a result
bound to another subject satisfies no planned assessment

constraints.statement: Bind a returned assessment to producer, subject, basis and evidence to authenticate it. This establishes neither assertion provenance of the expected answer nor execution provenance of the run; the referenced foundation requires these separately. Plan membership authenticates nothing. Unauthenticated results satisfy no required assessment, and results for another subject satisfy no planned assessment. No cryptographic or transport protocol is prescribed.
constraints.uncertainty: The separate provenance requirements are referenced but not supplied in full.

exceptions: The governing basis may explicitly state that two activations of one model family are independent for the particular semantic claim.

grounding.quote:
Independence across actor families is declared, not assumed. Whether two
activations of one model family are independent for a semantic judgment is a
policy the governing basis states for the claim; the default where it is not
stated is that they are not independent.

constraints.statement: Declare cross-family independence rather than assume it. Absent a claim-specific policy, two activations of one model family are not independent for semantic judgment.

grounding.quote:
The review names it
as not performed and reports no core value for it, neither
`indeterminate` nor `falsified`

constraints.statement: Return exactly one core result for each declared predicate evaluated, carrying every review-result field. A planned but unevaluated predicate is explicitly not performed and receives no core value, including neither indeterminate nor falsified. Keep it distinct from an undecided predicate and from required coverage lacking any planned assessment. A finding without evidence a consumer can chase is commentary. The review may recommend a disposition as evidence but applies no disposition.
constraints.uncertainty: The full conjunction treatment of these distinct missing/undecided populations is external.

conditions: Technical triage is returned.

grounding.quote:
A recommended disposition
is evidence for the decision owner: it is not a disposition, a
priority or a boundary effect, and it is never adopted mechanically

constraints.statement: Severity remains assessment evidence; priority, boundary effect and disposition remain distinct decision-owner values even under Product-defined mappings. A recommended disposition is none of those decision values and is never mechanically adopted. The adopting profile declares triage fields; the adopting Product binds scales and priority/boundary policy. This separation applies to every assessor/decision-owner configuration, with Reviewer/Executive retained as a profile instance.

conditions: A core result exists.
exceptions: For satisfied, another exact consumed result supplying a finding can make priority and boundary effect applicable.

grounding.quote: | satisfied | an explicit no-finding state; triage `not_applicable`; evidence, residuals and invalidation stay present | priority and boundary effect are `not_applicable` to this result unless another exact consumed result supplies a finding |

constraints.statement: satisfied: explicit no-finding state, triage not_applicable, with evidence/residuals/invalidation retained; priority and boundary effect not_applicable subject to the stated exception. falsified: one or more exact findings, complete triage where supported, indeterminate fields where evidence cannot close them; apply Product policy without mechanically converting severity to disposition. indeterminate: partial finding/observation, indeterminate triage, exact gaps and uncertainty; retain uncertainty or reactivate capable evaluation, never consume as satisfaction or a closed finding. out_of_frame: undeclared material relation or missing evaluator capability, indeterminate triage naming that deficit and exact reconfiguration pressure; refine/reconfigure a capable activation, keep the claim unresolved, and consume as neither satisfaction nor falsification. invalid_basis: basis failure, not_applicable triage, invalidation evidence and repair pressure; refuse consumption and return through the declared basis re-entry relation. A predicate not performed has no payload; payload indeterminate cannot stand for it.
constraints.uncertainty: This retains the supplied total projection as a declarative constraint, without executing a result conversion.

conditions: An observation lies outside the evaluated claim.

grounding.quote:
The assessor returns to the decision owner, not to the constructor. It does
not edit the candidate, direct the repair or authorise continuation

constraints.statement: Return the observation separately without replacing the claim-relative result, with triage not_applicable to that claim and exact repricing/re-entry pressure. The decision owner routes it to its declared owner without a claim-relative block or another review round from severity alone. In every review return, the assessor returns to the decision owner, not the constructor, and neither edits the candidate, directs repair nor authorises continuation.

Acceptance is limited to the unchanged evaluated subject and its named instance and interval. Close a work item by its stated condition; reviewer approval is only an input. Green labels, document/review counts and historical outcomes are not acceptance. The governing basis names acceptance boundary, interval and owner; the work item names its closing condition.

conditions: A human decision is exercised through a proxy.

grounding.quote:
for acceptance, a change a proxy cannot make re-enters at its owning
relation
a proxy's identity stays distinct from the human authority's

constraints.statement: The proxy must be explicitly admitted and bounded by the human authority's scope and exclusions, and retains an identity distinct from that human authority. IDENTITY §6 owns grant contents and FOUNDATIONS §2 owns decisions proxies can never make. A change outside proxy power re-enters at its owning relation.
constraints.uncertainty: The full grant schema and absolute proxy exclusions are not supplied.

conditions: The subject is a successor.

grounding.quote:
A claim whose disposition is
unresolved cannot be qualified and so cannot be accepted

constraints.statement: Include the successor disposition record with its exact immutable predecessor cut and one semantic disposition for every predecessor claim capable of affecting the successor. An unresolved disposition prevents qualification and acceptance; it is not a falsification. An intentionally removed disposition is the current Product authority's decision, and its record is that decision.
constraints.uncertainty: RELEASE §9's disposition domain and evaluation procedure are external.

conditions: A finding is considered for the current promotion boundary.

grounding.quote: These conditions are necessary.

constraints.statement: A verdict is bounded by the exact reviewed claim and applicable hard stops. A finding can block only if at least one condition holds: it falsifies that claim; exposes competing or ambiguous authority on its acceptance path; violates applicable active authority, safety or retained accepted behaviour; or establishes a material architectural decision with durable consequences foreclosing an admitted Product outcome. conditions: A finding meets a necessary blocking condition.
